ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 30-40% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and peduncle regions, contrasted against 60-70% high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous low-intensity (black) region originating from the notch and spreading towards the mid-ventral surface. Large high-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the outer lateral lobes. Small-scale low-intensity mottling is localized at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 105-115 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced at the distal 1/3 of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave upward sweep trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of low-intensity pixel groups located at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting localized scarring or prior colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity linear disruptions observed; notable diagonal marks on the right lobe and shorter, irregular linear marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear rake marks across the high-intensity fields of both lobes; visible irregularities and uneven erosion on the trailing edge contour at the lobe extremities.
